verdict.rationale: Paperspace lets users create custom machine templates (paperspace-docs-3, paperspace-docs-25) and run container images via Deployments (paperspace-docs-8), plus SSH root access to VMs for custom setups (paperspace-docs-12, paperspace-docs-19). Community reports (paperspace-comm-7) note friction getting reliable SSH/console access on Core VMs, which tempers confidence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that custom Docker images run smoothly end-to-end, and clearer detail on template versioning/sharing.
